## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.23

This release improves the Audio Sync queue UI and progress feedback.

### Changed

- The Audio Sync queue panel is taller so more queued jobs are visible.
- Queue Summary and Raw log now stay accumulated for the whole queue run.
- Queue progress now tracks total queued checkpoints instead of resetting for each job.
- The status label shows current/total queue job context while analyses run.

### Notes

- Manual single Audio Sync analysis behavior is unchanged.
- The automatic Audio Sync result to Organizer queue bridge from 1.0.22 is unchanged.
